synthetic_data_notice: All scenarios, sequences, and states in this file describe a fictional, synthetic educational simulation modelled on crowd density monitoring at FIT HANU (Khoa Công nghệ Thông tin, Trường Đại học Hà Nội). This is NOT a real traffic feed or a real campus occupancy system.

scenarios.description: Crowd density in the FIT Nhà C hallway stays LOW almost the whole run — typical of an early-morning off-peak slot or the period after 5 PM when most lab sessions have ended. Sensor noise is mild.
scenarios.expected_direction: The estimated hidden state should track LOW for nearly the entire sequence with only rare, brief deviations.

scenarios.description: Crowd density cycles LOW → HIGH → LOW quickly — typical of a class change when all AIN301 students leave Lab C1 together then quickly leave the building. Stresses the Markov assumption.
scenarios.expected_direction: The estimated state sequence should move in the same up-then-down direction as the true state, though it may lag by one or two steps.

scenarios.description: Same underlying crowd process as the committed seed-42 run (200-step FIT Nhà C hallway day), but with heavy sensor noise (30%) — e.g. a faulty IR sensor or a camera angle obstructed by a notice board.
scenarios.expected_direction: Estimation accuracy against ground truth should be visibly lower than the noise=0.05 run; exact state recovery at every step is not expected.

scenarios.description: A shorter, heavily-noised run where sensor readings often point away from the true hidden crowd state — simulating a sensor failure near Lab C2 during a busy afternoon at FIT HANU.
scenarios.expected_direction: A naive single-observation heuristic should disagree with the correct hidden-state direction at several steps; report whether your estimator resists this by using the transition model.

required_experiment.description: Run generate_sequence with the same seed and length at noise_level 0.05, 0.15, and 0.30 (the three committed files). Report how estimation accuracy against the ground-truth hidden-state column changes as sensor noise increases. Interpret results in terms of what they mean for a real FIT HANU crowd-monitoring system deployed in Nhà C.
